Listening before building

What changes when we start with a real difficulty?

1 min read

A request for a new button can point to a deeper difficulty. When someone describes the last time they got stuck, the steps they took and the way they worked around it, we can see more clearly what needs to change.

Sometimes the useful change is a clearer guide or a better default. Sometimes an existing tool already solves the problem. Listening gives us a chance to choose a smaller, more practical response.

If you share a difficulty, tell us about one recent example and what a better outcome would look like. Share only the details you’re comfortable including.
